purpose: Durable DANTE-owned decision to attempt one bounded Auth/security email without delegating lifecycle truth to the transport provider.

columns.name: email_intent_ref
columns.meaning: Stable UUIDv7 identity of the durable email intent.

columns.name: purpose_code
columns.meaning: Bounded Auth/security purpose that determines rendering and payload interpretation.

columns.name: stream_code
columns.meaning: Operational stream classification; currently fixed to auth_security.

columns.name: recipient_address
columns.meaning: Normalized delivery address snapshot used for this intent.

columns.name: recipient_comparison_key
columns.meaning: Normalized recipient comparison key used for suppression lookup.

columns.name: template_code
columns.meaning: Repository-owned template identity.

columns.name: template_revision
columns.meaning: Immutable repository template revision used by this intent.

columns.name: locale_code
columns.meaning: Locale snapshot for deterministic rendering.

columns.name: operation_scope
columns.meaning: Bounded idempotency operation scope.

columns.name: idempotency_key
columns.meaning: Caller-provided idempotency identity within operation_scope.

columns.name: supersession_key
columns.meaning: Optional identity used to cancel older undelivered intents when a proof is rotated.

columns.name: payload_fingerprint
columns.meaning: Purpose-separated keyed SHA-256 fingerprint used to detect idempotency conflicts without exposing short secrets.

columns.name: sensitive_key_id
columns.meaning: Short-lived email payload encryption key identifier; null after wipe.

columns.name: sensitive_nonce
columns.meaning: AES-GCM nonce for the protected short-lived payload; null after wipe.

columns.name: sensitive_ciphertext
columns.meaning: Authenticated encrypted delivery payload required only until terminal/ambiguous disposition.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: Intent creation instant.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.meaning: Last lifecycle mutation instant.

columns.name: eligible_at
columns.meaning: Earliest instant at which a worker may claim the intent.

columns.name: expires_at
columns.meaning: Hard deadline after which unsent work is expired.

columns.name: dispatch_state_code
columns.meaning: DANTE dispatch lifecycle state; provider acceptance remains distinct from downstream delivery observations.

columns.name: claim_token
columns.meaning: Exact worker claim identity while dispatch_state_code is claimed.

columns.name: claimed_until
columns.meaning: Lease deadline for the active worker claim.

columns.name: attempt_count
columns.meaning: Number of provider attempts admitted so far.

columns.name: attempt_limit
columns.meaning: Bounded maximum provider attempts for the intent.

columns.name: next_attempt_at
columns.meaning: Earliest retry instant after an explicit retryable provider failure.

columns.name: last_error_code
columns.meaning: Privacy-safe bounded last operational error code.

columns.name: accepted_at
columns.meaning: Instant the provider explicitly accepted the message; not evidence of delivery.

columns.name: terminal_at
columns.meaning: Instant DANTE stopped automatic processing for this intent.

columns.name: sensitive_wiped_at
columns.meaning: Instant protected delivery material was irreversibly removed from canonical persistence.

unique_constraints.name: uq_email_delivery_intent_operation_idempotency
unique_constraints.reason: Database arbiter for exact operation-scoped idempotency.

check_constraints.name: ck_email_delivery_intent_uuidv7
check_constraints.reason: Require stable UUIDv7 identity without deriving chronology from it.

check_constraints.name: ck_email_delivery_intent_purpose_code
check_constraints.reason: Keep the subsystem bounded to reviewed Auth/security email purposes.

check_constraints.name: ck_email_delivery_intent_template_identity
check_constraints.expression_contract: template_code = btrim(template_code) AND template_code <> '' AND template_revision = btrim(template_revision) AND template_revision <> ''

check_constraints.name: ck_email_delivery_intent_idempotency_identity
check_constraints.expression_contract: operation_scope = btrim(operation_scope) AND operation_scope <> '' AND idempotency_key = btrim(idempotency_key) AND idempotency_key <> ''

check_constraints.name: ck_email_delivery_intent_payload_fingerprint_length
check_constraints.reason: Require exact SHA-256 keyed fingerprint length.

check_constraints.name: ck_email_delivery_intent_sensitive_bundle
check_constraints.expression_contract: (sensitive_key_id IS NULL AND sensitive_nonce IS NULL AND sensitive_ciphertext IS NULL) OR (sensitive_key_id IS NOT NULL AND sensitive_key_id = btrim(sensitive_key_id) AND sensitive_key_id <> '' AND octet_length(sensitive_nonce) = 12 AND octet_length(sensitive_ciphertext) >= 16)
check_constraints.reason: Require all-or-none authenticated encrypted payload material.

check_constraints.name: ck_email_delivery_intent_dispatch_state_code
check_constraints.reason: Bound the dispatch lifecycle and preserve ambiguity explicitly.

check_constraints.name: ck_email_delivery_intent_claim_state
check_constraints.expression_contract: (dispatch_state_code='claimed' AND claim_token IS NOT NULL AND claimed_until IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(claimed_until)) OR (dispatch_state_code<>'claimed' AND claim_token IS NULL AND claimed_until IS NULL)
check_constraints.reason: Bind lease data exactly to the claimed state.

check_constraints.name: ck_email_delivery_intent_attempt_budget
check_constraints.expression_contract: attempt_limit > 0 AND attempt_count >= 0 AND attempt_count <= attempt_limit

check_constraints.name: ck_email_delivery_intent_chronology
check_constraints.expression_contract: isfinite(created_at) AND isfinite(updated_at) AND isfinite(eligible_at) AND isfinite(expires_at) AND updated_at >= created_at AND eligible_at >= created_at AND expires_at > created_at

check_constraints.name: ck_email_delivery_intent_accepted_at
check_constraints.expression_contract: accepted_at IS NULL OR (isfinite(accepted_at) AND accepted_at >= created_at)

check_constraints.name: ck_email_delivery_intent_terminal_at
check_constraints.expression_contract: terminal_at IS NULL OR (isfinite(terminal_at) AND terminal_at >= created_at)

check_constraints.name: ck_email_delivery_intent_sensitive_wiped_at
check_constraints.expression_contract: sensitive_wiped_at IS NULL OR (isfinite(sensitive_wiped_at) AND sensitive_wiped_at >= created_at)

indexes.name: ix_email_delivery_intent_claimable
indexes.reason: Bounded worker claim ordering and eligibility lookup.

state_history.current_binding: Current dispatch state is DANTE-owned technical lifecycle; provider delivery observations remain separate evidence rows.
state_history.chronology: Explicit timestamps and attempt rows preserve operational chronology without treating UUIDv7 as time authority.
state_history.immutability_policy: Recipient, template, idempotency and fingerprint identity are immutable after creation; only reviewed lifecycle columns may change.

lifecycle.retention: Technical delivery metadata is retained only under the bounded Auth/security retention policy; protected proof material is wiped at terminal, ambiguous, superseded, expired or recovery-quarantined disposition.
lifecycle.redaction: Short-lived OTP/recovery payloads are AES-256-GCM protected and removed when no longer required for delivery.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE; lifecycle is represented by explicit terminal/cancelled/quarantined states.

obligations: Real PostgreSQL migration, idempotency, claim/lease, ambiguity, sensitive-wipe, recovery quarantine and least-privilege ACL proof.
